description: The Start page: getting started, common actions, recent solutions, tips and links to the documentation.
setting.showOnStartup: Show the Start page when Codalus IDE starts.
setting.onboarded: Get Started is done: the Start page no longer offers the theme, keyboard scheme and imports first (Help → Get Started shows them again).
start.defaultVsCodeResharperOr: Default, VS Code, ReSharper or Emacs keys
start.settingsAndKeyBindingsFrom: Settings and key bindings from VS Code's user folder
start.aFileExportedWithTools: A file exported with Tools → Export Settings
start.hideGetStartedHelpGet: Hide Get Started (Help → Get Started brings it back)
start.solutionsYouOpenWillBe: Solutions you open will be listed here.
start.toggleWhetherThisPageOpens: Toggle whether this page opens when Codalus IDE starts.
tip.0: Search commands, settings, files and symbols from the box in the title bar
tip.1: Go To All finds any file, type or member by name
tip.2: Every shortcut can be changed, and four keyboard schemes are built in
tip.3: Fonts and Colors overrides any syntax, editor or window color over the theme
tip.4: Save window layouts and switch between them from the Window menu
tip.5: Distraction-free mode hides everything but your documents
tip.6: Bring your VS Code settings and shortcuts over in one step
tip.7: Export your settings, shortcuts and layouts to one file for another machine
tip.8: The integrated terminal runs your own shell next to your code
tip.9: C# Interactive evaluates C# as you type it
scheme.default.description: The classic IDE's keys: F5 debugs, F6 builds, Ctrl+Q searches
scheme.vscode.description: F1 is the command palette, Ctrl+, opens Settings, Ctrl+W closes
scheme.resharper.description: The default with ReSharper's: Ctrl+Shift+R refactors, Ctrl+W expands the selection
scheme.emacs.description: The default with Emacs's editing keys and Ctrl+X chords
